title: Trip Protection Cancel For Any Reason Benefit and Its Cancellation Cutoff
content:
On a Trip Protection plan whose CFAR reimbursement percentage is above 0.00, the insured guest may cancel the stay for any reason. This endorsement wording sets when the Cancel For Any Reason (CFAR) benefit is paid and how it is measured.

## Endorsement

1. **Cancel for any reason.** On a plan whose CFAR reimbursement percentage is above 0.00, the guest may cancel for any reason.
2. **Cutoff.** A CFAR benefit is paid only when the guest cancelled at least the plan's CFAR cutoff of elapsed hours before the start of the stay's check-in date. The hours are counted back from 00:00 on the stay's check-in date to the stay's cancellation moment, and a cancellation exactly at the boundary qualifies. Both moments are read from the system record of the stay the policy insures.
3. **Amount.** The CFAR benefit is the plan's CFAR reimbursement percentage of the stay's total price less every Roamhaven refund issued on the stay.
4. **Covered reason on a CFAR plan.** A cancellation for a covered reason on a CFAR plan is paid as a trip cancellation benefit instead, at the trip cancellation percentage, which is the higher of the two.

## Timing on the boundary

For a cutoff of H hours, the latest qualifying cancellation moment is H elapsed hours before 00:00 on the check-in date.

| Stay's cancellation moment | CFAR timing met |
|---|---|
| Earlier than H hours before 00:00 on the check-in date | Yes |
| Exactly H hours before 00:00 on the check-in date | Yes; a cancellation exactly at the boundary qualifies |
| Later than that moment | No |

**Hypothetical illustration (cutoff taken as 30 hours for illustration only).** Check-in date 10 July. 00:00 on 10 July less 30 hours is 18:00 on 8 July. A stay cancelled at 18:00:00 on 8 July qualifies; one cancelled at 17:45 on 8 July qualifies; one cancelled at 18:05 on 8 July does not.

## Amount on a hypothetical stay

Stay total price 3000.00 USD; Roamhaven refunds issued on the stay totalling 1000.00 USD. The amount the CFAR percentage is applied to is 3000.00 less 1000.00, that is 2000.00 USD, and the CFAR benefit is the plan's CFAR reimbursement percentage of 2000.00 USD.

## Which benefit a cancellation on a CFAR plan falls under

| Reason for the guest's cancellation | Benefit |
|---|---|
| A reason in the plan's covered reasons | Trip cancellation benefit, at the trip cancellation percentage |
| Any other reason | CFAR benefit, at the CFAR reimbursement percentage, paid only when the cutoff in item 2 is met |
